description: This file defines the 'AudioInputDeviceObserver' class, which manages system audio input devices. It provides functionality to observe device changes, retrieve default input device info, enumerate active devices, and check device states using CoreAudio APIs. It is likely used for monitoring and responding to microphone input device events in a macOS application.

classes.name: AudioInputDeviceObserver
classes.description: Manages system audio input device monitoring and querying using CoreAudio APIs, allowing registration and deregistration of device change event listeners, and providing device information such as UID and name.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceUID
methods.description: Returns the UID of the default audio input device, or nil if not available.

methods.name: aliveInputDeviceUIDs
methods.description: Returns a set of UIDs for all alive input audio devices currently connected.

methods.name: hasUsableDefaultInputDevice
methods.description: Checks if the default input device exists and is active with input channels.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceSummary
methods.description: Provides a string summary of the default input device, including its name and UID.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts listening for device changes and default input device updates, executing a callback on change.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops listening for device change notifications and cleans up listeners.
